name: Lilongwe open markets (the Lilongwe market)
subtitle: Lilongwe's open markets are the main food source for most residents.

facts.label: Reliance
facts.value: Over 80 percent of residents use open markets for food

facts.label: Largest
facts.value: The Lilongwe market is the largest in the city; traders work in day and evening shifts

facts.label: Newer markets
facts.value: Wakawaka and Tsoka grew up informally

parts.text: Lilongwe's open markets are the main food source for most residents. The council reports 41 designated markets, the largest being 'the Lilongwe market'.
